title: Female Graduate, Proud Family Gathering - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A smiling young woman in graduation cap and gown stands proudly centered among six family members, likely parents, grandparents, and siblings. The group is bundled in coats, hats, and formal suits outdoors in front of a tree and campus buildings. A photo lab border stamp on the right edge reads 'MAR • 66', marking a proud milestone during a transformative era of expanding higher education opportunities for women in the 1960s.
